textContent:
Lisha, apprentice Artisan, reporting for duty!
 
✦Duration✦
2026-10-08 04:00 - 2026-10-26 03:59 (server time)
 
✦Rewards✦
Astrite x500, Forgery Premium Supply - Lahai-Roi x4, Premium Enclosure Tank - Land of Xuanfang x8, Premium Resonance Potion x10, Premium Tuner x100, Shell Credit x640000 and other Materials.
 
✦Eligibility✦
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Four Chime Shaftpost during Main Quest Chapter IV Act I "The Wind Before the Storm."
 
✦Event Rules✦
- During the event, you will enter a special Sonoro Sphere to battle waves of enemies within a set time limit, with the aid of unique buffs.
- You collect Coins by dealing damage to enemies, and lose Coins when taking damage.
- Advancing through enemy waves unlocks more special buffs to give you the support you need.
- Clearing a wave grants bonus time. The Coins you have collected by the end of the countdown will be your Coins record for this stage.
